description: Optional automatic receipt at session end. Inert unless enabled (see README). Returns immediately; work runs detached.

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks-handlers/session_end.py"; for p in python3 python 'py -3'; do $p -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec $p "$f"; done; echo "session-receipt: no Python 3.10 or later found (tried python3, python, py -3)" >&2; exit 1
